barriers.reason: The 8:00 AM wound-center visit requires leaving around 6:15 AM on two buses, the patient has no car, the person they stay with sleeps mornings (works nights), and they have already missed Monday visits because Monday buses are unreliable and the foot makes travel slow.

alternatives.text: Ask the wound center for a later start time or a different weekday that fits the patient's bus schedule and avoids the hardest Monday morning trips.

If the foot condition prevents using fixed-route buses/trains, apply for ADA Paratransit certification through the Northern Illinois Transit Authority (312-663-HELP); note certification takes time and rides run only when fixed-route service runs.

If the patient has Medicaid or dual coverage, contact the managed-care plan (number on the plan card) or Transdev for fee-for-service to explore non-emergency medical transportation to wound-care visits; confirm coverage and advance-booking rules first.
